description: GTK music client for Jellyfin, Subsonic, Navidrome, and local libraries
pre_install: if ($global) { abort 'Rufin is installed per user and cannot be installed globally.' }
if (Get-Process -Name rufin -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { abort 'Close Rufin before installing or updating.' }
pre_uninstall: if (Get-Process -Name rufin -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { abort 'Close Rufin before updating or uninstalling.' }

script: if ($process.ExitCode -ne 0) { abort 'Rufin could not be uninstalled.' }
if (Test-Path $installDir) { abort 'The Rufin install directory was not removed.' }
